name: Apple
overview: Scripture uses the apple both as a literal fruit and a powerful metaphor to illustrate God's tender care and protection for His people. The phrase 'apple of the eye' appears in Deuteronomy, Psalms, and Proverbs, emphasizing the preciousness and guardedness with which God watches over His followers. Additionally, Proverbs likens wise words to 'apples of gold in pictures of silver,' highlighting the value of godly speech. Joel's mention of the apple tree among withered trees symbolizes a loss of joy among people, reinforcing the fruit's representation of blessing and vitality.
